title: 瑞银全球研究主管：中国权益资产回归，10-15%上行空间从何而来？
speaker: UBS APAC Global Research Head (name not stated)

segments.en: So I think this is the base case and of course looking into some of the investor concern, we spoke to them a lot.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这是基准情景，当然我们也关注市场参与者的部分担忧，并与他们进行了大量交流。

segments.en: Definitely I think China is coming back on the scene partly because of its ability to offer diversification.
segments.zh: 我认为中国肯定在重回视野，部分原因是其提供分散配置的能力。

segments.en: If you look at China, I think even on the back of some concerns about what's happening globally on the AI capax, etc.
segments.zh: 如果你看中国，我认为即便全球AI资本开支等方面存在一些担忧。

segments.en: Conversely, we are still forecasting like 10% earnings growth and without a much challenging valuation.
segments.zh: 相反，我们仍预测约10%的盈利增长，且估值并不太具挑战性。

segments.en: I think over the last couple of years, if you look at PE as always been below historical average.
segments.zh: 我认为过去几年，市盈率一直低于历史平均水平。

segments.en: So if you apply that, I think still like 10 to 15% upside from here is comfortable for China.
segments.zh: 所以如果应用这一点，我认为中国仍有10%至15%的上行空间是舒适的。

segments.en: This is 10% earnings growth on which index in China. This is for MSI China.
segments.zh: 这是中国哪个指数的10%盈利增长？这是MSCI中国指数。

segments.en: Okay, this is a broad index.
segments.zh: 好的，这是一个宽基指数。
